scope: Metadata-only review of algae/filter, carbonate, cellulose, liquid and high-purity material LIBS controls; no changes to v1/v2 models or protocols.
conclusion: None of the reviewed candidates establishes all required provenance, composition-bound, wavelength-medium, accessible-data and spectral-coverage conditions for a new independent Fe/Mg blank evaluation of the current instrument profile. This is a bounded search result, not proof that no suitable public dataset exists.
admission_rules: An analytical blank or unspiked control is not automatically an Fe/Mg-negative material.
Nominal formulation zeros, a missing element, and absent LIBS emission are not independently measured impurity bounds.

A documented total mass purity can bound all residual impurities jointly only if its basis, actual sample identity and certification apply to the measured material; processing, binder and substrate contamination must also be accounted for.
Elemental mass fractions, oxide equivalents, surface loadings and solution concentrations must not be interchanged without a documented conversion and mass denominator.
Ambient gas or a vacuum chamber does not declare whether the exported wavelength axis uses air or vacuum wavelengths.
Another instrument or incomplete wavelength coverage cannot be silently treated as validation of the frozen ChemCam profile.
Replicate laser shots are not independent physical blank materials.

candidates.title: Influence of sample matrix and filter fixation on LIBS signal in analysis of algae on filter
candidates.dataset_license: CC-BY-4.0, explicit in Zenodo API metadata
candidates.composition_evidence: The sample blank is a filter rim outside the algae area; the control contains algae without added Zn/Ni. The paper reports nonzero ICP-MS blank/control results and treats Mg as a matrix element. Concentrations discussed as surface loadings do not establish the required bulk oxide fractions. No qualified Fe/Mg impurity upper bounds were located.
candidates.wavelength_medium: not explicitly established in reviewed article or record metadata
candidates.instrument_and_grouping: Different SP and DP LIBS arrangements, tape layers, algae/control/filter conditions. File names identify conditions; independent material and session grouping still requires documentation.
candidates.metadata_inventory: The API file inventory contains txt/asc spectral files and tif shadowgraphs; no separately named README or chemical concentration table was found. Spectral files were not opened.

candidates.title: Comparative Evaluation of Spectroscopic Sensor Modalities for the Quantification of Calcium Carbonate
candidates.composition_evidence: Sixteen CaCO3/CaO formulation pellets include nominal pure endpoints. No matched Fe/Mg assay, impurity certificate or upper bound was located. A 100% nominal mixing proportion does not prove chemical purity.
candidates.raw_availability: Article contributions and author inquiry statement; no standalone downloadable raw blank dataset was located. No inquiry sent.

candidates.title: Calibration strategies for the direct determination of Ca, K, and Mg in powdered milk and solid dietary supplements
candidates.composition_evidence: Microcrystalline cellulose serves as an analytical blank and a dilution material. The zero entries in its formulation table are not a certified Fe/Mg impurity assay. The reported Mg analytical quantification limit is method performance, not a certified bound on the cellulose lot.
candidates.wavelength_medium: not explicitly established in reviewed sources
candidates.raw_availability: Open article PDF located; no separate licensed raw spectra or sample-linked purity certificate located.

candidates.title: Novel Calibration Approach for Monitoring Aerosol Hydrogen Isotopes Using LIBS for Molten Salt Reactor Off-Gas Streams
candidates.dataset_license: Article/supplement access; separate raw dataset license not established
candidates.composition_evidence: The experiment uses Milli-Q water, commercial D2O described as 99.99%, filters, and high-purity argon. Neither water resistivity nor unspecified D2O purity basis establishes matched Fe/Mg limits for the ablated filter or aerosol path. The D2O percentage must not be assumed to be a certified total-metals mass purity.
candidates.raw_availability: Article points to a 773.5KB supplementary ZIP; archive and intensities were not opened because composition and wavelength prerequisites were unmet.
blockers: current profile coverage and instrument compatibility

candidates.title: Direct LIBS Analysis of Estuarine Suspended Particulate Matter Collected on Filters
candidates.composition_evidence: Blank glass-fiber filters have intrinsic elemental emission, treated as stable substrate background. The study presents relative signals rather than independent quantitative Fe/Mg assays; no certified filter impurity bounds were found.
candidates.wavelength_medium: not explicitly established; the vacuum reference concerns filtration pressure
candidates.raw_availability: Article states that generated/analyzed data are included in the publication; supplementary archive is 49.9KB and described for summary variability tables. No raw blank file inventory established.

candidates.title: Enhanced toxic trace element detection in water using LIBS and a femtosecond laser-engineered substrate
candidates.composition_evidence: The paper specifies Al substrates above 99.99% purity, with chemical surface treatment and deposited Cr/Pb/As solutions. No sample-linked total-mass purity certificate or Fe/Mg bounds for the complete processed target were located. Nominal substrate purity alone cannot certify the deposited sample.
candidates.raw_availability: Data available from authors on reasonable request; no request sent.

candidates.title: Rapid Analysis of Steel Powder for 3D Printing Using LIBS
candidates.composition_evidence: Section 2.2 explicitly reports certified 99.995% Fe and 99.99% Mn powders from Beijing Research Institute for Nonferrous Metals. The measured series S0-S10 contains 95-100% nominal Fe; it is not a low-Fe series. S0 is potentially informative for Mg only. Certificate documents, purity basis and preparation contamination are not resolved.
candidates.conditional_impurity_inference: If those purities are certified total mass fractions for the actual lots, residual impurities jointly are at most 0.005 wt% in Fe powder and 0.01 wt% in Mn powder; these are conditional feedstock bounds, not assigned final-spectrum labels.
candidates.raw_availability: No standalone raw spectrum download located.
blockers: raw data and actual-lot certificate linkage

candidates.title: Elemental analysis of LIBS aided by an empirical spectral database
candidates.composition_evidence: Table 3 lists forty elemental targets and nominal purities, including 99.99% graphite and 99.999% phosphorus/sulfur. It does not supply lot-linked impurity certificates or Fe/Mg upper bounds. These entries are leads, not certified negative labels.
candidates.wavelength_medium: not explicitly established on the accessible primary landing page
candidates.raw_availability: Historic empirical library identified; no current licensed raw download or grouping manifest established in this review.

candidates.title: A novel strategy for preparing LIBS calibration standards using beeswax as a substrate
candidates.composition_evidence: The method quantifies Fe and Mg in beeswax-based cosmetic/oil preparations with independent analytical comparisons. Accessible primary material reports detection limits, not a sample-specific certificate or upper confidence bound for Fe/Mg in the unspiked substrate. Detection limits alone cannot be relabeled as blank concentrations.
candidates.wavelength_medium: not explicitly established in accessible primary material
candidates.raw_availability: No public licensed spectrum dataset located; primary preview is accessible.

additional_leads_sent_to_parent.lead: forageLIBS documentation lists 365 physical samples/368 measurements, independent Fe mg/kg and Mg percent assays; 199.4-822.2nm. Wavelength convention, licensing and current-profile coverage need resolution. No spectral values opened.
NIST SRM915c calcium carbonate certification could establish impurity metadata, but no public LIBS spectrum of that exact certified material/lot was identified; not a control dataset by itself.

limits: Unavailable or missing evidence is reported as not established, not as proven absent. No author contact, new fitting, threshold selection, raw-file preview or candidate prediction was performed.
